T54. Solves 49/50 — ONE solve left. Best = R2053 (my turn-53 design): feed 34/2.6/2.6/0.8 + B 40/4.0/4.0/0.45 DOUBLE EFFECT f=0.5, LP dp 0.9. Reward 1.656, revenue $1047.4M, cost $320.9M. Heat link FORMED: HP condenser 367K vs LP reboiler 344K, 53 MW, saves $37.3M/yr, shared exchanger $1.9M/yr. B cost $106.5M.

Key lessons: (1) The double effect on B is the big win — hp dp 0.45 (retain 0.55) + LP dp 0.9 (retain 0.10) gave enough T gap for the link. (2) Feed column 34/2.6/2.6/0.8 is the $214.5M cost driver; trims that keep BT C6-paraffin blend >=95% hold revenue ~$1050-1060M. (3) BT purity sits right at the 95% blend threshold — feed-split changes risk collapsing revenue. (4) Extra columns on T or BB were all money-losing (R2037 0.511, R2031 0.826) because C3-C5 and C7-C9 splits are expensive and the cuts stay impure.

Decision: with one solve left, do not gamble. Revert to the best valid design (free re-eval, unchanged settings) and finish. Final score 1.656.
